# Homepage artwork fixtures

Real title/artwork pairs retrieved read-only from the public provider records listed in `sources.json` on October 24, 2026. These small samples make deterministic visual QA show actual cover artwork rather than invented posters. Rights remain with their respective owners; provider/source links are retained as provenance.

Only synthetic local test records and explicitly labeled QA accounts use these files. They are not production assets, seed data, a recommendation list, or evidence of live Trove availability. The production homepage renders only artwork already attached to existing catalog records and real eligible public shelf picks; it never queries providers to build the page.
